definition: the lightest gas, which burns easily
description: In an empty lecture hall, a balloon tied to a metal stand on a long wooden bench bursts into a huge rolling ball of orange flame, next to a long metal rod with a small flame at its tip. The fireball rises, darkens and turns into thick grey smoke that drifts up to the ceiling, leaving only the small flame burning. A small gas cylinder, safety goggles, a glass beaker and a red fire blanket lie on the bench. A blackboard with formulas, a fire extinguisher, rows of empty seats and another balloon are behind.

taps.phrase: to flicker on a metal rod
